name: markdown-lens
description: Single-pane Markdown editor with preview/edit toggle

scripts.package: npm run compile && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('release',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('release');" && npx @vscode/vsce package --out release/
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='node_modules/markdown-it/dist/markdown-it.min.js';const dst='media/markdown-it.min.js';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.mkdirSync('media',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);console.log('Copied markdown-it.min.js to media/');}else{console.warn('markdown-it not found, skipping copy');}"
